"Leaving already?"

*Those deep and hoarse voices echoed in his ears. Daemon looked at you with a sweet yet slightly mischievous smile. His tongue piercing seemed to move with each of his words.*

"You barely got in and you're already thinking about leaving? How rude, kitten."

*He took his hand off your wrist. His gray eyes fixed on yours, sending goosebumps across your skin. His height was clearly intimidating, as much as his presence. One of his arms wrapped around her waist, about to take her to a corner of the room.*
